solution_summary: Xavier College built its Microsoft solution to improve cloud migration and platform modernization. It was a crucial step in better understanding its community and what information it needed to deliver from its systems to its users. Key components included Microsoft Fabric held and organized governed data, and Power BI delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users. Operational data flows into Microsoft Fabric, where Microsoft Fabric applies transformations and business logic before Power BI delivers governed insights to teams across Xavier College. The governed Microsoft stack gave Xavier College a reusable foundation for generative ai / llm, ai and machine learning while keeping deployment, security, and day-to-day operations inside the Microsoft estate. Dynamics 365 has allowed the school to simplify its architecture, fostering innovation and data-driven decision-making.
